entities.how_described: 本集贯穿的概念:AI 获得主观能动性(如 Waymo 例子)需要足够的钱、护栏和训练;管理上同理——给团队主观能动性,但要配上正确的护栏和培训,否则「你的智能体会去做你不想让它做的破事」。

evidence.quote: How do you give agents what we call true agency?

entities.name: zero-day
entities.how_described: 本集的核心数据:零日漏洞行业平均 55 天才修好,而 AI 找到并发起攻击只要几分钟——攻防时间差被压缩到分钟级是新的核心指标。

evidence.quote: If you found a vulnerability, a zero-day vulnerability, the average time to fix those 55 days.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: You know, if you found a vulnerability, a zero-day vulnerability, the average time to fix it was 55 days in the industry.

entities.name: governance

evidence.quote: I think a lot of the AI labs want to get ahead of it, make sure there is some governance framework around it to ensure that they can keep developing the technology at the pace at which they'd like to.
